text: The certificate-error test keeps promiseAlertDialogOpen setup before testCallback, then waits for the connection alert. The 2024 FolderLoaded workaround is historical: the accepted test fetches messages and waits on adjusted unread count, or expands a server root to discover its inbox. It also tests the warning icon and tooltip separately. Preserve the watcher-before-action ordering; no intermittent timeout was reproduced, and certificate validity or accessibility is not proven by this static inspection. Static inspection supports this component scope. No runtime test was run for this lesson, and full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is still pending.
title: Install certificate-dialog waiting before requesting messages
